## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Website Development
- Custom Business Websites
- High-Converting Landing Pages
- Next.js / React Web Applications
- E-commerce Stores & Client Portals
- Typical Investment: $800 - $3,500 USD

### 2. AI Automation & Workflows
- Automated Business Workflows (n8n, Make, Zapier)
- Custom AI Conversational Chatbots & Support Agents
- CRM & Lead Nurturing Automations
- API System Integrations
- Typical Investment: $1,200 - $5,000 USD

### 3. Design & Branding
- Logo Design & Vector Identity
- Brand Guidelines & Typography Standards
- UI/UX Interface Design (Figma)
- Social Media Kits & Pitch Decks
- Typical Investment: $500 - $1,500 USD

### 4. IT & Software Services
- Technical Consulting & Cloud Architecture
- Custom API Development & Webhooks
- Server & Database Management
- Ongoing Maintenance & SLA Support
- Typical Investment: $900 - $4,000 USD
